# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unmodified UMD bundle from the npm package `@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0`, downloaded using npm pack with npm integrity verification. Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js. License: MIT. This file is served locally so sign-in does not depend on a JavaScript CDN. Update by downloading a pinned, integrity-verified release and rerunning the auth and database tests.
